mapProjectionChecks: WMTS georeferencing, lunar radius, exact target bounds and UV orientation pass; these are not independent image-to-terrain controls.
reason: No defensible independent landmark control set established in the dark coarse WAC crop; source metadata states 12–300 m absolute accuracy, and no frame correction has been measured.
disposition: Shaded elevation is the default. Optional LROC WAC must be labeled registration unverified.
